pages.text: Beatable alone in iron armour with a dog. These are the dark age's fallout, not its masters. They wander near home and you will meet them whether you look or not.$(br2)$(bold)Mutant Zombie$() holds $(bold)Brass$().$(br)$(bold)Mutant Skeleton$() holds $(bold)Recruiting$().$(br)$(bold)Mutant Creeper$() holds $(bold)Blasting$().

$(bold)Mutant Snow Golem$() (snow) holds $(bold)Climate control$(): thermoregulators, fans, air conditioners. Wool and leaf clothing stay free.$(br)$(bold)Mutant Enderman$() holds $(bold)Ender logistics$(): Create's long-distance chutes and vaults.$(br)$(bold)Torte$() (Nether) holds $(bold)Advanced cooking$(): Slice & Dice automation.

Brass is the hinge of the whole tree: mechanical crafters, deployers, arms, trains, the smart funnels and filters that make a factory think. Zinc plus copper in a mixer over a blaze burner. The dead took the knowledge; the Mutant Zombie carries it.
pages.title: Why brass

pages.text: $(bold)Blasting$() covers TNT, gunpowder recipes, the blaze burner and musket cartridges. $(bold)Recruiting$() is hiring from Village Recruits; guards stay free.$(br2)A fresh server should clear Tier 1 in its first week.
